analysis_provenance.export_validation: All 56 exported instructions (224 bytes) independently compared to reference PT_LOAD file bytes after subtracting Ghidra image base 0x10000. All equal. No pseudocode/binary excerpts retained.
analysis_provenance.analysis_method: ELF symbol names/sizes and direct Capstone A32 disassembly of only these four functions; existing export metadata used for provenance. No Ghidra reimport or new decompilation.
analysis_provenance.dependency: Direct BL target 0x000d24fc is strcmp: validated ARM PLT slot (20-byte header, 12-byte entries) against .rel.plt relocation and dynamic symbol strcmp.

builds.scope: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer; LeakSanitizer disabled, no leak verification claimed.

builds.compiler_version: Android (13989888, +pgo, +bolt, +lto, +mlgo, based on r563880c) clang version 21.0.0 (https://android.googlesource.com/toolchain/llvm-project 5e96669f06077099aa41290cdb4c5e6fa0f59349)
builds.execution: Not executed on an ARM device. Target layout static_assert checks passed. Original ARM instructions are executed separately in the local oracle.

result.scope: Original ARM control flow vs host candidate; strcmp modeled by Python byte-string comparison. Synthetic data only. No engine/asset integration.

oracle.method: Reference ELF mapped into Unicorn only for offline comparative testing. Candidate host executable emits deterministic fixture results; Python checks original return values and lookup comparison traces against them.
additional_checks: Original functions preserve r4-r11 and SP; no non-stack writes accepted.
Lookups leave the complete synthetic 64-KiB data arena unchanged.
272 strcmp calls: exact ID/query pointer arguments and order checked, including stopping at the first duplicate.
Host test snapshots all fixture object bytes; no mutation allowed.
Negative and zero counts avoid null names/arrays; case distinctions, empty names, prefixes and a high-bit byte are exercised.
Geometry addresses include zero/high-bit bases and INT32_MIN/INT32_MAX indices; invalid return addresses are never dereferenced.
scope_limits: strcmp is modeled with Python byte-string ordering, not original libc execution.
Synthetic layouts only; no real assets, Android lifecycle, allocation/ownership or gameplay integration.
64-bit host image/material layouts adapt to native pointers; exact ARM32 offsets/strides are enforced by target static_asserts.
All four original function control flows are exercised; full original C++ types, complete classes and ABI interoperability remain UNVERIFIED.

matching_evidence.method: Extract each complete candidate STT_FUNC byte range from ARM ET_REL .text and compare directly with its reference ELF PT_LOAD bytes. Require identical lengths/bytes and no candidate relocation in the matched range. No normalization.
matching_evidence.matched_scope: Only 0x00710700: all eight bytes identical, no relocations; executable body only. Other three remain NOT MATCHED.

integration.invalid_inputs: Lookup count > 0 requires valid arrays and NUL-terminated ID/query strings; native code has no checks. Source preserves these preconditions. No invented error/success stubs.

attempts_and_failures: Initial GCC -Werror host build rejected a null-name test after inlining unreachable strcmp; changed only the fixture to read null from a volatile pointer. Final GCC and Clang builds pass with warnings as errors.

Initial ARM build used NDK default frame pointers and matched none. Explicit -fomit-frame-pointer removes leaf prologues and produces the exact eight-byte checkVersion body. Other functions still differ in register allocation/control flow.
Initial private export checker treated hex address strings as integers; corrected conversion and reran all 56 instruction comparisons successfully.

handoff.result: Four source-owned operations and standalone tests added. One eight-byte body matched; three NOT MATCHED. No original data committed and no runtime original dependency.
